heading: Definitions
lead: For the purposes of this subchapter, the following definitions apply:

tree.heading: Conservation Area
tree.text: The term “Conservation Area” means the Las Cienegas National Conservation Area established by section 460ooo–3(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Acquisition Planning District
tree.text: The term “Acquisition Planning District” means the Sonoita Valley Acquisition Planning District established by section 460ooo–1(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Management plan
tree.text: The term “management plan” means the management plan for the Conservation Area.

tree.heading: Public lands
tree.text: The term “public lands” has the meaning given the term in section 1702(e) of title 43, except that such term shall not include interest in lands not owned by the United States.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.
